parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/RadioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the two methods — `playCallsUnderlyingPlayer` (line 22) and `radioPlayerStopCallsUnderlyingPlayer` (line 37) — share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.727), they are distinct test cases exercising different behaviors (play vs. stop) on the underlying player. Collapsing them would obscure test intent and reduce failure-message clarity, which is the primary value of separate test methods.
